framework_name: OWASP Top 10 for Large Language Model Applications

LLM01.name: Prompt Injection
LLM01.description: Manipulating LLM behavior via crafted inputs causing unauthorized actions or bypasses.

LLM02.name: Sensitive Information Disclosure
LLM02.description: Unintended disclosure of confidential data, secrets, or internal system context in LLM outputs.

LLM03.name: Supply Chain Vulnerabilities
LLM03.description: Risks from compromised third-party models, datasets, plugins, or vector databases.

LLM04.name: Data and Model Poisoning
LLM04.description: Tampering with training data, fine-tuning samples, or vector stores to introduce backdoors.

LLM05.name: Improper Output Handling
LLM05.description: Inadequate validation/sanitization of LLM output before passing to downstream systems.

LLM06.name: Excessive Agency & Tool Misuse
LLM06.description: Granting excessive autonomy, permissions, or unchecked tool calling capabilities to an LLM.

LLM07.name: System Prompt Leakage
LLM07.description: Exposing system prompts or internal operational instructions via adversarial prompt queries.

LLM08.name: Vector and Embedding Weaknesses
LLM08.description: Flaws in vector indexing, retrieval permissions, or distance thresholds causing unauthorized data exposure.

LLM09.name: Misinformation
LLM09.description: LLM producing false, hallucinated, or unverified output causing decision errors.

LLM10.name: Unbounded Consumption
LLM10.description: Resource exhaustion, high API cost, or DoS due to unrestricted query processing.
